subject: Private/VPC security discovery — post-call recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Private/VPC security discovery — post-call recap and next steps

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Call recap (30 min):
- Use case: Acme will run customer-facing search and summarization features backed by a private Redwood deployment (VPC).
- Security asks: SOC 2 status, GDPR/data residency controls, HIPAA support for PHI redaction, network isolation and air-gapped options.
- Primary blockers: procurement wants SOC 2 report & vendor questionnaire completed; infra needs a deployment diagram for networking review.

Action items / next steps (proposed):
1) We will send our private deployment diagram (attached) and a short SOC 2 summary. [attachment: redwood-private-deployment-diagram-v1.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf]
2) Please send over your vendor security questionnaire (or we can drop our standard spreadsheet). We attached a blank vendor security questionnaire that tends to speed the process. [attachment: vendor-security-questionnaire-acme.xlsx]
3) Schedule a security deep-dive with our infra/security engineers to walk the diagram and firewall/NAT/VPC peering expectations (I included a Calendly link below).
4) Provide required timelines for procurement (targeting a go/no-go for Dedicated/Private decision by end of month).

Notes on private deployment options we discussed:
- VPC Peering / PrivateLink: preferred for low-latency, secure traffic between Acme VPC and Redwood-managed infra.
- Customer-managed VPC (Private): we can provide a control plane in a customer VPC and/or an on-prem agent for air-gapped installs (options vary by compliance needs).
- Air-gapped: available as an on-prem installer; we’ll need to confirm hardware/OS baseline and support window.

Let us know if I missed anything. I’ll follow up tomorrow with the attachments and a link to initiate the questionnaire.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0148

--

Subject: Re: Private/VPC security discovery — post-call recap and next steps

Marcus — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers:

- SOC 2: We require SOC 2 Type II. Can you share the report or at least an executive summary today? Procurement will need it to progress.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We operate in EU & US; HIPAA applies to a subset of our customers. We’ll need redaction/PHI controls documented.
- Vendor questionnaire: attaching our standard security questionnaire (we’ll also upload to Procurement portal). Timeline: procurement wants completed questionnaires within 10 business days.

We’re reviewing the diagram you attached and will come back with any network questions. For the security deep-dive, Priya and our network lead Kevin will join — can you confirm available times?

Appreciate it,
Alex
Head of Product Security | Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

If you prefer, we can also set up a short call between our security lead and Kevin to map firewall rules and connection testing.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.
